mutants.description: The fault-log timebase prescaler is set with ms_to_sw_cycles(1) instead of the clk-based package value. The timestamp counts clk ticks, so a 'millisecond' tick comes every 450 clocks (9 us) instead of every 50000.
mutants.reason: timestamp_ms advances about 111 times too fast. So the TIME_0..2 registers (0x18-0x1A) and the FTIME episode-start bytes (0x1E-0x20) read over SPI report elapsed time far larger than the real milliseconds since reset or since the fault.

mutants.description: The Red_LED1 strike blink half-period is sized in switching cycles (ms_to_sw_cycles(125)), to match the clean-run window it was chosen against. But fault_LED's blink counter counts clk ticks, so it gets 56250 clocks (about 1.1 ms) instead of 125 ms.
mutants.reason: While strikes are outstanding (strike_level non-zero, no latch), Red_LED1 toggles about every 1.1 ms instead of every 125 ms, so the 4 Hz strike blink at the port becomes roughly 440 Hz.
